profile.subtitleJa: 使徒言行録2章で来訪者の出身地域として挙げられる歴史的地域名。
profile.summaryJa: 北東アフリカの歴史的な国・地域名です。使徒言行録2章10節では、エルサレムにいた人々の出身地域の一つとして列挙されます。古代の範囲は時代により変わり、現代の国境とは同一視しません。

facts.textJa: ヨセフが兄弟たちに売られてエジプトへ移されたと語られる。
モーセが生まれ、父の家で三か月養育されたと語られる。

profile.modernLocationJa: 古代エジプトの範囲は時代により変化し、現在のエジプト国境とは一致しない。ここでは地域として扱う。
profile.historicalRoleJa: 使徒言行録2章10節で来訪者の出身地域として挙げられる。
profile.locationNoteJa: 割当候補座標だけでは根拠にできない。今回の作業では該当地名のPleiades固定データまたは考古学機関資料を個別確認できていないため座標はnull。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
“The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him
and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.
Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.
But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.
Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;
“But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,
Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.
I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’
This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.
to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,
saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.
